files.content:
# Idle / Incremental Game Eval Brief

Client: Boreal Desk, a home-office accessories company.
Audience: operations leads who need an artifact they can use this week.

Fixed source facts for grounding:
- The returns desk pilot covered 18 SKUs.
- Median first response improved from 18 hours to 6 hours.
- Preventable refund leakage fell from 14.2% to 8.9%.
- The top unresolved complaint is status silence after photo submission.
- Required next actions are automated status emails, barcode-exception training, and a weekly Finance exception export.

Use these facts when the task asks for prose, analysis, copy, UI content, or test data. Do not use live web services, real credentials, or current outside data.

Craftbook under test: idle-clicker-game - Idle / Incremental Game.

success.summary: index.html is a complete self-contained browser game smoke artifact.

checks.pattern: restart|play again|new game|game over|victory|you win|you lose

axes.name: playability
axes.description: The game is actually playable: input works, state advances, and a session can be completed.

axes.name: completeness
axes.description: Core loop, scoring/win-lose, and restart are all present rather than stubbed.

axes.name: polish
axes.description: Visual design and feedback (motion, states, messages) feel deliberate, not default.

axes.name: robustness
axes.description: No console errors, dead controls, or states the player can get stuck in.
